Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, learned senior counsel assisted 
by Mr. B.S. Bora, learned counsel for the Petitioner.
2. Mr. Arvind Vashishta, learned senior counsel assisted 
by Mr. Rachit Manglik, learned counsel for the caveator.
3. As per office report, objections have been filed on 
behalf of the Respondent.
4. Learned senior counsel for the Petitioner prays for and 
is granted three weeks’ time to file rejoinder affidavit.
5. List this matter for final hearing on 10.02.2026.
6. Till the next date of listing, the effect and operation of 
the impugned judgment and order dated 17.08.2024 passed in 
Small Cause Suit No.4/2023 “Samar Pal Singh and others Vs. 
Arif and others”, as well as the judgment and order dated 
13.11.2025, passed in Civil Revision No.8/2025, “Arif Vs. 
Samar Pal Singh and others”, passed by the court of learned 
1st Additional District Judge Kashipur, District Udham Singh 
Nagar, shall remain stayed.
7. Stay application (IA No.1/2025) stands disposed of 
accordingly. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
